architecture.note: Sparse mixture-of-experts. Paper: 'Mixtral has the same architecture as Mistral 7B, with the difference that each layer is composed of 8 feedforward blocks (i.e. experts).' A router selects 2 of 8 experts per token per layer. 46.7B total parameters, 12.9B active per token. Pretrained from scratch, not fine-tuned from Mistral 7B weights (Mistral AI release post).

positional_encoding.note: Config not fetched this session; likely rotary as in Mistral 7B, per the 'same architecture' claim, but not independently confirmed.

training_data.value: Pretrained from scratch; neither the paper nor the release post discloses the training corpus.
